purpose: Verify full POAM integration and whole-field clarity monitoring; three paired development scenarios, not a statistical superiority claim.
selection: Declared before inspecting completed mission outcomes. All runs, including regressions, collisions and optimizer fallbacks, retained.

primary_metric: Time integral of unweighted mean positive clarity deficit over all 475 uniform-area cells.
physics: Independent spatial vortex/jet fields; identical seed and observation-noise stream per pair.
qoi: Independent-cell clarity dynamics evaluated on executed positions; entire rectangle, including remotely sensed cells under flight obstacles.
wind: Full POAM predictive covariance including conditional residual; online inducing relocation, variational updates, attentive-kernel training. Known simulated observation noise.
sampler: Full prior covariance draw on a 29x23 spatial support; 16 Sobol spectral nodes per RBF component for the retained between-support residual; followed by sparse-posterior Matheron conditioning. Full predictive covariance used for inference. Sampling covariance errors tested on grid and off-grid.
performance_revision: The first 128-node attempt was terminated before the first planning result to optimize algebraically equivalent field evaluation. Its log and initial protocol are retained. No mission outcome was selected or discarded. A second spectral-only attempt was stopped before a completed mission after the separate survey revealed 12–17% posterior sampling covariance error. The corrected sampler reduces this to 0.22–0.27%; both aborted development logs are retained.
